settings.heading: Thoughtful Gifts for Little Celebrations
settings.intro: The best children's gifts aren't played with once—they become part of everyday adventures. Thoughtfully handcrafted and designed to grow with little ones, each keepsake finds a place in daily life, making birthdays, baby showers, naming ceremonies, return gifts and milestone celebrations truly memorable.
settings.hero_alt: Hand block-printed baby quilt rolled and tied with twine, in a basket with animal print fabric.
settings.trust_design_detail: Every gift can be personalised with exclusive hand block prints, custom colours, names, monograms and thoughtfully curated combinations — creating return gifts parents love to give and children love to keep.

settings.heading: Swaddle Sets — The Gentlest Welcome.
settings.image_alt: Two hand block-printed swaddle sets rolled and tied with twine, in pink floral and blue animal prints, gift-wrapped in a basket.
settings.body: A thoughtful gift for newborns and growing families, our hand block printed swaddles become everyday essentials—from swaddling and nursing to stroller outings, tummy time and comforting cuddles.

settings.heading: Pencil Pouches — Made for Little Creators.
settings.image_alt: A hand block-printed pencil pouch with a frog print being handed from a mother to her daughter.
settings.body: Perfect for birthday return gifts, these beautifully crafted pouches become trusted companions for school, travel, art supplies and every new creative adventure.

settings.heading: Multipurpose Utility Pouches — One Pouch. Endless Adventures.
settings.image_alt: A row of hand block-printed quilted utility pouches with animal prints and tassels, being gift-wrapped with ribbon.
settings.body: From tiny treasures and toys to travel essentials, toiletries or favourite keepsakes, these versatile pouches grow with children and find new purpose at every stage.

settings.heading: iPad & Stationery Sleeves — For Curious Little Minds.
settings.image_alt: A hand block-printed submarine-print tablet sleeve open on a desk with a notebook and coloured pens.
settings.body: Designed to safely carry books, sketchpads, stationery and tablets, these sleeves make thoughtful gifts for school, travel, creative time and everyday learning.

settings.heading: Backpacks — Ready for Every Little Adventure.
settings.image_alt: A hand block-printed quilted backpack in a floral bunny print, styled with flowers and a gift bag.
settings.body: Whether it's preschool, playdates, holidays or weekend outings, a beautifully handcrafted backpack becomes a favourite companion that children reach for every day.

settings.heading: Quilts — Comfort That Grows With Them.
settings.image_alt: Hand block-printed baby quilt rolled and tied with twine, in a basket with animal print fabric.
settings.body: More than a quilt, it's a soft playmat for early years, a comforting companion for naps and story time, and a treasured keepsake that stays with a child long after the celebration has passed.
